clue.text: Careful examination of country girl

parts.note: Peru is a South American country
Sal is a girl's name, short for Sally or Sarah

explanation.surface: A close inspection of a young woman from the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: A perusal is a thorough reading or inspection, so it is a careful examination.

clue.text: Intrinsically American hero

parts.note: per se is Latin for in itself, intrinsically
US is short for American, United States

explanation.surface: A truly American hero is held up.
explanation.definitionFit: Perseus is the Greek hero who slew Medusa.

clue.text: Campion, a scruffy fellow

definitions.meaning: campion is a wild flower, one species of which has ragged pink petals
a robin in rags, a tatty man named Robin

explanation.surface: Someone named Campion is a scruffy chap.
explanation.walkthrough: Campion reads like a surname, but it is a wild flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Ragged robin is a pink wild flower of the campion family; literally, a tattered Robin.

clue.text: Security given by Peter to youthful beginners

parts.note: peter is old criminal slang for a safe

indicators.note: the beginners of words are their first letters, taken from to and youthful

explanation.surface: A man called Peter offers protection to young novices.
explanation.walkthrough: Peter looks like a name, but it is slang for a safe, as in a peterman, a safecracker.
explanation.definitionFit: Safety is freedom from danger, the state of security.

clue.text: Part of new York unfortunately losing ground

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests something gone wrong, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
land means ground

explanation.surface: A part of New York is having bad luck with lost territory.
explanation.definitionFit: Long Island is the island east of Manhattan containing the boroughs of Brooklyn and Queens.

clue.text: Noise of rebel about to leave on the first of the month

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: Dec is the standard abbreviation for December
the first is I, the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: to leave says the next letters are taken away from the word rebel

parts.note: taken as written
re is Latin for about, as in business letters

explanation.surface: A rebel's racket is set to subside at the start of a new month.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking RE ('about') away from REBEL leaves BEL, which goes on DEC I, read as 'the first of the month', December 1st.
explanation.definitionFit: A decibel is the unit used to measure loudness, so it stands for noise by association.

clue.text: Fruit with stone to take out

definitions.meaning: a palm fruit with a long stone inside
to take someone out on a romantic outing

explanation.surface: Someone removes the stone from a fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A date is a stoned palm fruit, and to date someone is to take them out.

clue.text: Welcher I mock in comic verse

indicators.note: mock suggests a sham version, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone ridicules a defaulter in a funny poem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mock' reads as ridicule, but it is the anagram signal on WELCHER plus I.
explanation.definitionFit: A clerihew is a four-line comic biographical verse, named after Edmund Clerihew Bentley.

clue.text: Stole a snake

definitions.meaning: a feather ... is a long scarf worn round the shoulders

explanation.surface: Someone stole a snake.
explanation.definitionFit: Boa is both a fluffy scarf and a large constricting snake.

clue.text: Still wearing old baby clothes

indicators.note: wearing means the word for old has the other piece on, around it

parts.note: late means former, old
yet means still

explanation.surface: An old man is still wearing infant garments.
explanation.definitionFit: A layette is the set of clothes and linen prepared for a newborn.

clue.text: Soldier right about set-up

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the soldier and right are read backwards together

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
R is the usual abbreviation for right; that the answer's letters also open the word right is a coincidence

explanation.surface: A soldier who has done an about-turn in a military arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A rig is an apparatus or arrangement, a set-up of equipment.

clue.text: Cherchez la femme — there's a trick to it

definitions.meaning: French for look for the woman, an instruction to hunt for the lady
the three-card trick in which the punter must pick out the queen

explanation.surface: A French saying about women is followed by the hint that there is a knack involved.
explanation.walkthrough: Find the lady is the street con also called three-card monte: the punter must spot the queen among three cards shuffled face down.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a literal translation of the French, and also the name of a card swindle.

clue.text: Emotionally charged, Circe let fly

indicators.note: to let fly is to throw wildly, so these letters are scattered and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: The enchantress Circe loses her temper in a highly charged moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let fly' reads as a phrase meaning lose one's temper; here 'let' is fodder and 'fly' alone is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An electric atmosphere is thrilling and tense, so the word means emotionally charged.

clue.text: Feeling of resentment with opening of the game

parts.note: pique is irritation from hurt pride

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, taken from the

explanation.surface: Someone feels sore as a game begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Piquet is a card game for two players using a short pack.

clue.text: Caged by superior heathens, one bird is in dire straits

parts.note: U means upper class, superior

indicators.note: caged by means one piece is held inside the word for heathens

parts.note: pagans are heathens
I is the Roman numeral one
a tit is a small bird

explanation.surface: A bird caged by posh heathens is in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Up against it is an idiom for facing great difficulties.

clue.text: Flowers to cultivate without moving

parts.note: stocks are scented garden flowers
to till land is to cultivate it

explanation.surface: Flowers are grown without being shifted.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock-still means perfectly motionless.

clue.text: Work out sequence of heads or tails

indicators.note: sequence of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone tries to make sense of a run of coin tosses.
explanation.definitionFit: To sort out a problem is to resolve or work it out.

clue.text: Collecting silver is not stupid, and very popular

indicators.note: collecting means the phrase takes the silver inside itself

parts.note: someone all there is mentally sharp, not stupid
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A shrewd silver collector is much in demand.
explanation.definitionFit: Something all the rage is the current craze, extremely fashionable and popular.

clue.text: One given to contemplation loses heart to go-between

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter goes

parts.note: a meditator is someone who meditates

explanation.surface: A meditative person loses courage and becomes a negotiator.
explanation.definitionFit: A mediator negotiates between disputing parties.

clue.text: Gawper with attribute useful to contortionist

definitions.meaning: a gawper is someone staring nosily, especially at an accident
read literally, a very flexible neck that a contortionist would value

explanation.surface: A staring onlooker is described as having a contortionist's bendy body part.
explanation.definitionFit: A rubberneck is a gawping sightseer; read literally the phrase is a neck made of rubber.

clue.text: Clean up image — a term used in 12

parts.note: to rub up is to polish clean
an icon is an image

explanation.surface: Polish an image, a term from a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: 12 is PIQUET, the card game; a rubicon there is winning a game before the loser reaches 100 points.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubicon is a piquet scoring term for the loser failing to reach a set score.

clue.text: Get through the gap

definitions.meaning: to ... an exam is to get through it

explanation.surface: Someone squeezes through an opening.
explanation.definitionFit: Pass is both a verb for succeeding and a noun for a mountain route.

clue.text: Jersey has primarily sunny climate, but not hot

indicators.note: primarily means only the first letter of sunny counts
but not says the next letter is taken out of the climate word

parts.note: weather is climate
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Jersey enjoys sunny weather, though not hot.
explanation.walkthrough: Jersey looks like the Channel Island, but it is the knitted garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A jersey is a knitted pullover, a sweater.

clue.text: In the lead, sports official with a small house

indicators.note: in says the official and a go inside the symbol for lead

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
a ref is a referee

explanation.surface: A referee in front leads with a small house.
explanation.definitionFit: A prefab is a small prefabricated house, especially of the postwar kind.

clue.text: Gang joined by Italian brigand

parts.note: a band is a group or gang
It is the abbreviation for Italian, as in It vermouth

explanation.surface: A gang of robbers is joined by an Italian outlaw.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandit is an outlaw robber, the same as a brigand.

clue.text: Get on the wrong side of drill sergeant

definitions.text: Get on the wrong side of

indicators.note: drill suggests putting troops through their paces, so the letters are put into new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A recruit annoys the drill sergeant.
explanation.definitionFit: To estrange someone is to alienate them, setting them against you.

clue.text: Asia's greatest romantic architecture originated here

definitions.text: Asia's greatest romantic architecture originated here

indicators.note: where a word originates is its first letter, taken from each of the four words

explanation.surface: The site where Asia's finest romantic building began.
explanation.walkthrough: Agra is the Indian city of the Taj Mahal, a famous monument to love.
explanation.definitionFit: Agra is home to the Taj Mahal, a romantic mausoleum.

clue.text: Meet with disaster of geometric sort

indicators.note: sort as a verb means arrange, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone suffers a catastrophe of a geometric kind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort' reads as a noun meaning kind, but it is the anagram signal working on OF plus GEOMETRIC.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to grief is an idiom meaning to fail or end in disaster.

clue.text: Stick up for stupid person

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: gum is to stick

explanation.surface: Defend a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A mug is a gullible person.

clue.text: Child's finger, possibly

definitions.meaning: with the s read as is: a small child
a measure of spirits, as in a finger of whisky

explanation.surface: A youngster's digit is described.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', so the clue says a tot is a child, and a tot is also a small drink, measured perhaps as a finger's depth.
explanation.definitionFit: Tot means both a little child and a small dram of spirits.

clue.text: River spirit around in African country

indicators.note: around means the whole run of river and spirit is turned backwards

parts.note: the Aire is a river in Yorkshire
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: A river spirit roams round a country in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: The Aire is a Yorkshire river, a crossword regular; AIRE followed by GIN, all reversed, gives the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Nigeria is a country in West Africa.

clue.text: Surprise shown about best brew — had one for the pot?

indicators.note: about says the exclamation goes round the other letters

parts.note: lor is a dated cry of surprise, a form of Lord

indicators.note: to brew is to mix up, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is startled by a fine pot of tea, having made one for the pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one for the pot' recalls the extra spoonful of tea for the teapot, but the pot is a lobster pot, used to catch the creature.
explanation.definitionFit: Lobsters are caught in pots and cooked in pots, so one is a candidate for the pot.
